{{Quote|Trick or treat!|A popular saying during the Galactic Moon Festival|<ref name="SWG:GMF" />}}
The '''Galactic Moon Festival''' was an event celebrated at [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|All the citizens of Mos Eisley and Moenia gladly agreed to participate in the Galactic Moon Festival, when Jabba asked them. With a townsperson targeted, say 'Trick or Treat'. If they like your costume they will give you Galactic Moon Coins. If not, use your Trick or Treat device and scare them!|[[Z'ozpheratu]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GMF" />}}
[[File:MoeniaMoon.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Moenia during the Galactic Moon Festival]]
The Galactic Moon Festival was created by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to gain more support from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He grew tired of festivals of [[Festival of Love|love]] and [[Life Day/Legends|life]], so he aimed to create the scariest event of the year. He sent [[Aponte]] to advertise the event, while [[Z'ozpheratu]] was tasked with handing out costume holo-projectors in both cities.<ref name="SWG:DFtR">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68011&month=102008|text=Friday Feature – Don't Fear the Reaper}}</ref>

These holo-projectors would allow [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to "dress up" in a number of scary costumes, including [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]], [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]], and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. These celebrants would attempt to scare others with their costumes, by exclaiming, "Trick or treat!" If they were genuinely scared or impressed by the costume, the participants would be given [[Galactic Moon Coin]]s. These coins could be given to Z'ozpheratu in exchange for certain prizes.<ref name="SWG:GMF" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Galactic Moon Festival was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 5.10|Game Update 5.10]]," published on [[October 14]], [[2008]], in order to coincide with the real-world festival of [[Wikipedia:Halloween|Halloween]].<ref name="SonyCite-''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 5.10">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68016&month=102008|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 5.10}}</ref> The festival also shared similarities with [[Halloween/Legends|Halloween]].<ref name="SWG:GMF" />
